text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I spotted Ikuno Dictus talking with a 
student in the courtyard.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...Therefore, it would be advisable to 
reduce the afternoon routine by one set.

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
That makes total sense! It feels like this 
will really work! , Ikuno-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
No. As long as it was helpful, that's what 
matters.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The junior Umamusume bowed deeply and took 
her leave.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes. She asked if I could review her 
training menu.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Scheduling and management happen to be 
areas where I am relatively capable.
choice_data_list:
I'd like you to take a look at my schedule 
too.
I want you to look over my schedule too.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Scheduling and management happen to be 
areas where I am relatively capable.
choice_data_list:
I'd like you to take a look at my schedule 
too.
I want you to look over my schedule too.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: My schedule...? Is that what you mean?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Trainers should have studied scheduling 
during their training, so wouldn't this be 
unnecessary?
choice_data_list: Just sharing your thoughts is fine.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Hmm... Understood. Let me take a look.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...Today's schedule is packed with far too 
many routines.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Also, while I understand you're busy, 
please don't neglect your meals, sleep, 
and downtime.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
A Trainer's body is their greatest asset. 
Diet, sleep, rest... Never neglect these 
three essentials.
choice_data_list: Thanks, I'll keep that in mind.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
No, if it proved helpful, that is all that 
matters.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Now then, moving on to the next point of 
critique.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I'm not even halfway through pointing out 
all the issues yet. There is no way I can 
overlook such a reckless schedule.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Ikuno Dictus gave me a 
thorough, uncompromising rundown of all my 
flaws...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
The trick... If I had to say, it would be 
not letting the words mislead you.
choice_data_list: Are you sure you aren't being tricked?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes. In most cases, itineraries are 
written to highlight all the positives.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Extra running to build leg strength... 
sounds noble enough on paper.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
In truth, fatigue from physical exertion 
is also factored in. However, in most 
cases, that is omitted from the records.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I am merely pointing things out based on 
that. I don't know if you could call them 
tips or tricks, but I hope it proves 
helpful.
choice_data_list:
Thanks, I'll be careful not to get 
tricked.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: I am so glad to hear you say that.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...However, everything I've explained up 
to this point was a complete fabrication.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Just a joke. Though the explanation 
itself is entirely true.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
It seems you might need a little training 
in learning how not to get tricked.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Surprisingly, she seems to have quite a 
sense of humor. Then again, seeing through 
a lie told with a totally deadpan face 
probably takes more than a little 
practice……
